viewer.description: Viewer DID, used to report the viewer's own RSVP status.

main.description: Fetch a single event by AT-URI, hydrated with the organiser's profile and raw RSVP counts (going / interested) aggregated from app.zeens.rsvp records. For gated events (approvalRequired or capacityMode=waitlist) these raw counts are advisory; the SvelteKit layer overlays canonical approved/waitlisted counts from PocketBase, which Lua cannot see.
